summary: Both sides are deterministic tixy-style formula rotations on a red/cyan grid with a near-identical control surface and colour model, but the port cycles a different set of mini-formulas in a different order and holds each one 4.26x too long, and its SpeedShift/ColorShift defaults differ from the original's.
observations: ARCHITECTURE MATCHES: both sides render a 2D grid that switches between distinct mini-formula 'modes' on a fixed timer; both are fully deterministic (seeds 1, 7 and 1234 produce byte-identical renders on both sides at the same dials); both are resolution-independent (the same motifs, just finer, at --grid 32x32 as at the default 16x16).

UNTOUCHED DEFAULTS DIVERGE: the original renders a completely STATIC image untouched — meanBrightness pinned at 96, motion 0, zeroMotionFrames 300/300 over a 60 s survey, and still byte-frozen at --fps 3, 7, 23 and 47. The port animates untouched (survey mean 24, motion avg 7.6, brightnessTrend volatile). The original untouched render is bit-for-bit its sliderSpeedShift=0 render, so its SpeedShift default is 0; SpeedShift is the ONLY dial that unfreezes it (setting sliderMonoOrColor, sliderColorShift or sliderBrightShift alone leaves it at mean 96 / motion 0 over 30 s).

MODE DWELL IS 4.26x TOO LONG ON THE PORT. Mode switches show as isolated motion spikes; both sides' cadence is time-based and fps-invariant (orig 2.35 s at both 5 and 20 fps; port 10.05-10.2 s at both). Dwell is linear in SpeedShift on both: orig = 9.4*v s (v=0.1 -> 0.94, 0.25 -> 2.35, 0.5 -> 4.70, 0.75 -> 7.05, 1 -> 9.40); port = 40*v s (0.1 -> 4.00, 0.25 -> 10.05, 0.5 -> 20.00, 0.75 -> 30.05, 1 -> 40.05). Ratio 40/9.4 = 4.26 at every setting.

SPEEDSHIFT=0 ENDPOINT DIVERGES: the original freezes solid there (motion 0, identical to untouched — looks like a divide-by-zero on the time base). The port instead runs at its FASTEST there (dwell ~1.25 s, motion avg 32) — it appears to floor/clamp where the original degenerates.

MODE CONTENT AND ORDER ARE DIFFERENT. At dwell-matched dials (orig SpeedShift=1, port SpeedShift=0.235, both 9.4 s/mode, MonoOrColor=0, 100 s at 10 fps, label xdial-match), index-by-index: orig = quadrant checker / coarse red-cyan noise / block mosaic / vertical black-to-cyan gradient / solid cyan square / maze / regular dot grid / black / noise / noise / mountain-histogram. Port = 4x4 dot matrix with black gutters / concentric arcs / black / vertical bars / black / large checkerboard / sparse dots / double spiral / noise / solid red field / horizontal bars. No index matches.

MOTIFS EXCLUSIVE TO THE ORIGINAL within its first ~46 modes (mapped in 27 s chunks at 20 fps, SpeedShift=0.25, labels chunk-0/27/54/81): 2x2 quadrant checker (its mode 0), Sierpinski triangle at 14.7 s, a glyph/text motif that reads as 'TI' at 39.3-41.7 s, a face/box outline at 44.1 s, a bar-chart histogram at 46.6 s, a diagonal X cross at 54.0 s, a mountain/terrain histogram at 56.5 s, a radial pinwheel fan at 71.2-76.0 s, several diagonal moire fields. The port shows none of these in the same window.

MOTIFS EXCLUSIVE TO THE PORT in the same window: the 4x4 dot matrix with 1-px black gutters (its mode 0, 144 lit of 256 px), a double spiral (71-79 s), full-field solid-colour flashes (90.8 s), horizontal band pairs (99.9 s). The port does have a Sierpinski mode, but at 130.5 s in the 240 s survey, not at the original's index.

SHARED FAMILIES ARE DRAWN DIFFERENTLY: both sides have a concentric-arc mode. Parked in each side's own arc mode at SpeedShift=0.25 (orig --skip 31, port --skip 13, 20 fps filmstrips), the original's arcs are clean solid red/cyan bands sweeping outward fast (window motion 12); the port's arcs are checkerboard-dithered (arc x alternating-pixel mask) and barely move (window motion 2).

COLOUR MODEL MATCHES. sliderMonoOrColor is a binary switch on BOTH sides with the boundary in the same place (identical output at 0 and 0.25; identical output at 0.5, 0.75 and 1). Below the boundary both honour the pickers exactly: setting hsvPickerPositiveColor=0.33,1,1 and hsvPickerNegativeColor=0.66,1,1 gives measured hues 0.33 / 0.66 on both sides. Above it both map hue from the tixy value scaled by ColorShift, and ColorShift=0 gives a single hue 0 (red) on both.

ColorShift is GATED identically: inert at MonoOrColor=0 on both sides (renders byte-identical at ColorShift 0/0.5/1), live at MonoOrColor=1 on both. The probe's 'NO' for sliderColorShift on both sides is a false inert caused by this gate, not a missing dial.

COLORSHIFT DEFAULT DIVERGES: with MonoOrColor=1 and ColorShift untouched, the original renders exactly 1 hue (all hue 0, i.e. mono) while the port renders 14 distinct hues. Explicitly setting ColorShift=0 collapses both to 1 hue. So the port's ColorShift default is non-zero where the original's is 0.

PORT IS DIMMER at matched dials: whole-window meanBrightness 38 vs orig 61 in the dwell-matched 100 s run; 30 vs 96 untouched. Brightness dial character also differs: the original's saturates by mid-range (in a graded mode at t=38 s, meanV 23.7 at 0 then 195.2 at both 0.5 and 1), while the port's keeps scaling across the full range (at t=0, meanV 4.9 / 59.4 / 133.4 at 0 / 0.5 / 1, lit pixels 81 / 126 / 256).

CONTROL-SURFACE MISMATCH: the original exposes sliderBrightShift (label 'BrightShift'); the port exposes sliderBrightnessShift (label 'BrightnessShift'). The other five controls match by name and kind (hsvPickerPositiveColor, hsvPickerNegativeColor, sliderMonoOrColor, sliderColorShift, sliderSpeedShift).

ORIGINAL-SIDE FAULT (not a port bug): once animating, the ORIGINAL throws a runtime error 'call of a non-function value' (line 158, fn 11) and goes permanently black. It fires after a fixed NUMBER of mini-modes, not a fixed time: SpeedShift=0.1 crashed at t=43.65 s (dwell 0.94 s -> 46.4 modes), 0.15 at 66.65 s (dwell 1.41 -> 47.3), 0.25 at 108.05 s (dwell 2.35 -> 46.0). So the original walks off the end of a ~46-entry formula table. The port ran the full 240 s survey with no runtime error. This caps how much of the original's cycle is observable and means it never repeats within an observable window.

dials.name: hsvPickerPositiveColor
dials.origEffect: In the MonoOrColor<0.5 branch, sets the hue of positive-valued cells; setting 0.33,1,1 gives measured hue 0.33 on every positive pixel. Inert in the mono branch.
dials.portEffect: Identical: hue 0.33 on positive pixels with the same setting, same branch gating.

dials.name: hsvPickerNegativeColor
dials.origEffect: Sets the hue of negative-valued cells in the MonoOrColor<0.5 branch; 0.66,1,1 gives measured hue 0.66.

dials.name: sliderMonoOrColor
dials.origEffect: Binary switch, boundary between 0.25 and 0.5. Low = two-picker colouring (values 0 and 0.25 render byte-identically); high = hue-from-value colouring (0.5, 0.75, 1 render byte-identically).
dials.portEffect: Same binary switch, same boundary between 0.25 and 0.5, same two branches.

dials.name: sliderColorShift
dials.origEffect: Gated by MonoOrColor: inert in the picker branch, live in the hue-from-value branch where it scales hue per value level (measured hue step = 2*ColorShift; 0 -> single red, 0.05 -> 10 hues in 0.1 steps, 0.1 -> 5 hues in 0.2 steps).
dials.portEffect: Same gating and same direction (0 -> single red, rising values spread hue), but the port's untouched default is non-zero where the original's is 0, so the two disagree until ColorShift is explicitly set.

dials.name: sliderSpeedShift
dials.origEffect: Sets mode dwell linearly: dwell = 9.4*v seconds (0.1 -> 0.94 s, 1 -> 9.4 s). Higher = slower. v=0 freezes the pattern completely. Untouched default is 0, i.e. frozen.
dials.portEffect: Same linear law and same direction but 4.26x too slow: dwell = 40*v seconds (0.1 -> 4.0 s, 1 -> 40.05 s). v=0 does NOT freeze — it runs fastest (~1.25 s dwell). Untouched default behaves like ~0.25 (10 s dwell), not 0.

dials.name: sliderBrightShift / sliderBrightnessShift
dials.origEffect: Named sliderBrightShift. Raises overall brightness and saturates by mid-range: in a graded mode, meanV 23.7 at 0 then 195.2 at both 0.5 and 1.
dials.portEffect: Named sliderBrightnessShift (NAME MISMATCH). Raises brightness monotonically across the whole range without saturating early: meanV 4.9 / 59.4 / 133.4 and lit pixels 81 / 126 / 256 at 0 / 0.5 / 1; renders fully black at 0 and 0.5 in some modes.

feedback: Rename the port's control from sliderBrightnessShift to sliderBrightShift so the label reads 'BrightShift' and matches the original's control surface exactly.

Mode dwell is 4.26x too long. The original holds each mini-formula for 9.4*SpeedShift seconds (measured 0.94 s at SpeedShift=0.1 up to 9.4 s at 1.0); the port holds it for 40*SpeedShift seconds. Scale the mode timer down by 4.26 so dwell = 9.4*SpeedShift.

SpeedShift default is wrong. The original's untouched state is a completely FROZEN image (SpeedShift default 0, motion 0 at every fps); the port defaults to roughly 0.25 and animates with a ~10 s dwell. Set the port's SpeedShift default to 0 so the untouched render is static, and make SpeedShift=0 freeze rather than run at maximum rate (the port currently floors dwell at ~1.25 s at v=0).

ColorShift default is wrong. With MonoOrColor high and ColorShift untouched the original is monochrome red (exactly 1 hue); the port shows 14+ hues. Set the port's ColorShift default to 0 — with ColorShift explicitly 0 the two already agree.

The mini-formula table itself is different, and this is the dominant gap. At dwell-matched dials the port's mode 0 is a 4x4 dot matrix with black gutters where the original's mode 0 is a 2x2 red/cyan quadrant checker, and no later index lines up either. The original's list (~46 entries before it runs off the end) includes motifs the port never draws: a Sierpinski triangle at its index 6, a glyph/text motif reading as 'TI', a face/box outline, a bar-chart histogram, a diagonal X cross, a mountain/terrain histogram, and a radial pinwheel fan. The port instead draws a double spiral, full-field solid-colour flashes and paired horizontal bands that the original never shows. Rebuild the formula list and its order against the original.

Where a formula family is shared, match the drawing: the original's concentric-arc mode is clean solid red/cyan bands sweeping outward briskly (motion ~12 over a 3 s window at SpeedShift=0.25); the port's arc mode is multiplied by an alternating-pixel checkerboard mask and is nearly static (motion ~2). Drop the dither mask and speed up the arc phase.

The port is consistently dimmer at matched dials (mean 38 vs 61 over a dwell-matched 100 s window). Its brightness dial also has a different curve: the original saturates by BrightShift=0.5 (meanV 23.7 -> 195.2 -> 195.2 across 0/0.5/1) while the port ramps all the way to 1 (4.9 -> 59.4 -> 133.4) and blacks out entirely at 0 and 0.5 in some modes. Raise the port's base gain and make the dial saturate by mid-range.

Note for the fixer, not a port defect: the ORIGINAL crashes with 'call of a non-function value' (line 158) after ~46 mini-modes — 43.65 s at SpeedShift=0.1, 66.65 s at 0.15, 108.05 s at 0.25 — and goes black permanently. Do not reproduce that; the port correctly keeps running (240 s clean). But it does mean the original's list is bounded at ~46 entries, which is the target length for the port's table.
